observation_id.meaning: Unique measurement record, not evidence of independence

investigation_id.meaning: Verified investigation identity; BASS and BASS-II stay distinct

run_id.meaning: Verified experimental run within investigation and campaign

dependency_group_id.meaning: Globally unique cluster covering repeats and all related runs

material.meaning: Reviewed canonical fuel specification, not a loose alias
material.leakage_risk: Use only pre-outcome measurements; fit transformations inside each training fold

flow_direction.meaning: Concurrent or opposed relative to spread
flow_direction.leakage_risk: Use only pre-outcome measurements; fit transformations inside each training fold

gravity_regime.meaning: Reviewed gravity regime, such as microgravity

combustion_regime.meaning: Reviewed outcome/regime definition such as steady_solid_spread

flow_velocity_cm_s.leakage_risk: Use only pre-outcome measurements; fit transformations inside each training fold

oxygen_percent.meaning: Oxygen mole/volume percentage, not mass percentage
oxygen_percent.leakage_risk: Use only pre-outcome measurements; fit transformations inside each training fold

pressure_kpa.leakage_risk: Use only pre-outcome measurements; fit transformations inside each training fold

sample_width_cm.leakage_risk: Use only pre-outcome measurements; fit transformations inside each training fold

sample_length_cm.leakage_risk: Use only pre-outcome measurements; fit transformations inside each training fold

sample_thickness_mm.leakage_risk: Use only pre-outcome measurements; fit transformations inside each training fold

duct_height_cm.meaning: Verified confinement height with consistent definition
duct_height_cm.leakage_risk: Use only pre-outcome measurements; fit transformations inside each training fold

flame_spread_rate_cm_s.meaning: Measured flame-front displacement per elapsed time in the specified regime

outcome_unit.meaning: Must be cm/s after explicit conversion

verification_status.meaning: verified or synthetic; unreviewed blocks modeling

grouping_status.meaning: verified or synthetic; human review of dependency structure

geometry_status.meaning: verified or synthetic when geometry is selected

source_location.meaning: Table, figure, file or extraction location

data_origin.meaning: experimental or synthetic; mixing is forbidden
